note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: five dated customs export rows with named foreign consignees, destination ports, HS codes and bill-of-lading numbers, latest 2026-02-27, all routed through Hyderabad Air Cargo (INHYD4). Declared HS 293359 does not match the observed shipment HS 29420090 (other organic compounds / bulk drug substances) — per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the factual HS should be corrected to 29420090, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Product line is pharma APIs (Levetiracetam, Risperidone, Olmesartan Medoxomil, Lacosamide), consistent with the "Нефтегаз и химия" industry bucket only loosely — it is fine chemicals/API, not oil and gas. The same page also shows this entity as an importer from Chinese suppliers (Hangzhou Celor Chemical, Ningbo Sanger Medtech, Zhejiang Jingsheng Pharmaceutical), i.e. it imports intermediates and re-exports finished APIs — a manufacturer_trader pattern. Domestic Indian supply evidence is the one gap: no GST band, tender or contract data was publicly reachable, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found. Revenue and export volume figures are null — ImportKey does not publish values and I did not estimate them.
